title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Removal of…
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 have a vulnerability involving improper removal of sensitive information before storage or transfer. This flaw allows a low privileged attacker with local access to potentially expose sensitive information. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact integrity or availability.
